title: 第19章 亲往烟霞峰一探究竟第20章 这功法这么难的吗
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
看着激动得语无伦次的林清瑶。
陆鸣心中依旧觉得荒谬无比。
自己这无敌领域实在太无敌了。
连信口胡诌的话都能产生道蕴。
但他还等维持高人风范，对着林清瑶淡淡开口道：
“嗯，既已领悟其中关窍，那便好生修炼吧，切记，修行如逆水行舟，不进则退，切勿因一时之得而懈怠。”
“是！
师兄！
清瑶明白！”
林清瑶用力点头，迫不及待的重新坐在摇椅上运转《青霄蕴灵诀》开始修炼。
陆鸣伸了个懒腰，本想重新坐回躺椅上，可就在此时系统的提示声传来。
【叮！
林清瑶领悟《青霄蕴灵诀》，领域范围增加五米！
多少？！
陆鸣动作瞬间僵住。
五米？！
不是五厘米？！
系统你出BUG了吧？！
而在系统提示声传来的一瞬间，陆鸣便感受到了领域扩张带来的变化。
原本，院子的篱笆墙就是领域的大致边界。

而现在！
原本处于领域边界外的那片山坡林地，此刻有一部分清晰地纳入了他的领域之中。
先前那条妖蛇所徘徊的竹林也被一并纳入其中，当然只是一小部分。
真的……多了五米！
领域变大，安全区也相对增加。
今后陆鸣能随心所欲活动的地方也以木屋为中心向外呈圆形延伸出了五米。
加上之前的十二米，现在他的领域半径已经来到了十七米！
陆鸣深吸一口气，平复一番激动的心情。
往常增加范围都是按照厘米增加的。
甚至是林清瑶突破修为都只增加了十厘米，但这次却一次性增加了五米……
为何会这样？
是因为那功法吗？
所以这功法到底是什么来路？
陆鸣对此也想不出个所以然来，毕竟他没有灵气，也没修炼过。
更不可能知道那功法有什么特殊之处。
不过打破砂锅问到底不是陆鸣的性格。
与其想这种对他这个凡人来说不能理解的东西。
倒不如想想明天要做什么好吃的。
水煮牛肉？
或者摘点菜，弄点牛羊肉卷涮涮火锅？
content_en:
Looking at Lin Qingyao who was so excited and incoherent.
Lu Ming still felt ridiculous in his heart.
This invincible field of my own is too invincible.
Even nonsense can produce Tao aggregates.
But he still wanted to maintain his superior demeanor and said calmly to Lin Qingyao:
"Well, now that you have understood the key, let's start practicing. Remember, practicing is like sailing against the current. If you don't make progress, you will retreat. Don't slack off because of temporary gains."
"Yes!
Senior brother!
Qingyao understands! "
Lin Qingyao nodded vigorously and couldn't wait to sit on the rocking chair again and start practicing "Qingxiao Yunling Jue".
Lu Ming stretched out and wanted to sit back on the recliner, but at this moment the system prompt sounded.
【bite!
Lin Qingyao comprehended the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue", and the domain range increased by five meters!
How many? !
Lu Ming's movements froze instantly.
Five meters? !
Not five centimeters? !
Is there a bug in your system? !
The moment the system prompt sounded, Lu Ming felt the changes brought about by the expansion of the field.
Originally, the fence wall of the yard was the rough boundary of the domain.
And now!
The hillside woodland that was originally outside the boundary of the domain was now clearly included in his domain.
The bamboo forest where the demon snake wandered before was also included, of course only a small part.
Really... five meters more!
The field becomes larger and the safe zone increases accordingly.
From now on, the place where Lu Ming can move as he pleases also extends five meters in a circle from the center of the wooden house.
Including the previous twelve meters, his domain radius has now reached seventeen meters!
Lu Ming took a deep breath to calm down his excitement.
Usually the increase range is in centimeters.
Even Lin Qingyao's breakthrough cultivation level only increased by ten centimeters, but this time it increased by five meters at once...
Why is this happening?
Is it because of that technique?
So where does this technique come from?
Lu Ming couldn't think of a reason for this. After all, he had no spiritual energy and had never practiced.
It is even less possible to know what is special about that technique.
But it's not Lu Ming's character to break the casserole and ask questions.
Instead of thinking about something that is incomprehensible to him as a mortal.
It's better to think about what delicious food to make tomorrow.
Boiled beef?
Or pick some vegetables and get some beef and mutton rolls for hot pot?
